info.name: Mishwark Backend API
info.description:
Mishwark car-rental & chauffeur booking backend.

AUTH: POST /auth/otp/verify returns a JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Role routing: Customer, Driver, Super Admin.

SETUP: set baseUrl=http://localhost:5000, then run Verify OTP and copy the token into {token}.
Dev OTP bypass: code="0000".

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: { success, data, pagination? }. Errors: { message, errorCode, errors }.

request.description: A driver can attach the papers here as file fields nationalIdFront, nationalIdBack, licenseFront, licenseBack, criminalRecord: they are stored privately and the response lists them in `documents` (PENDING, or FAILED with the reason; a bad file never undoes the signup). Other file fields are dropped. Create a customer or driver account. Multipart/form-data — fields may arrive as JSON strings or files. The `role` flag defaults to 'customer'; admin roles cannot be self-assigned.

Email/password sign-in, step 1. Limits: 5 wrong passwords for one account from one device (IP) block that device from that account for 15 minutes (429, `errors.retryAfterSeconds`); the owner on another device is unaffected. 403 for a disabled account. Never returns a session: it answers with the next step and a `loginToken` (signed, 5 minutes): `passwordChangeRequired` (temporary password: call /auth/set-password), `twoFactorSetupRequired` (with `secret` + `qrCodeDataURL`: call /auth/verify-2fa-setup) or `twoFactorRequired` (call /auth/verify-2fa). 400 on a wrong email or password.

request.description: Public. Sends a 4-digit OTP to the phone; only phoneNumber is required (a new customer can give the name later with PATCH /auth/me). 403 for dashboard accounts. 01…, +20… and 0020… are the same number (stored as +20…). In dev the code is returned as dev_otp.

Public. Verifies the OTP and returns a JWT valid for APP_SESSION_DAYS (default 30) plus `profileComplete`. Dashboard accounts get 403 (they sign in with email, password and 2FA). Dev bypass code: 0000. Response drives role-based home screen.

const pick = (json) => { const list = (json.data && json.data.items) || json.data || []; return Array.isArray(list) ? (list[0] && (list[0].vehicleId || list[0].id)) : null; };

request.description: One bookable car with photos (cover first), features and luggage. 404 if it doesn't exist, is retired or has no driver.

PUBLIC. Server-side price. Send `serviceType` (WEDDING, TRIP, VIP) with `vehicleId`: WEDDING/VIP = the car's own fixed price (or the default) covering included hours and km, plus every started extra hour (send `startTime`/`endTime`) and every extra km; TRIP = from the company (Settings origin, unless startPoint is sent) to a listed `destinationId` (fixed price per car category) or to `endPoint` (the category's "another place" price), plus extra km beyond the included ones. The response adds `lines` (itemised: wedding|vip|trip|trip_other, extra_hours, extra_km, package_discount, referral_discount with quantity, unitPrice, included), `bookedMinutes`, `depositRate`, `destination`, the points used and `route` (source haversine = straight-line estimate). Without serviceType the older per-km price applies. 400 for a retired car or an inactive destination.

PUBLIC. Resolves startPoint/endPoint (coordinates or a place name) into distanceKm and durationMinutes. Coordinates are passed through; free text is geocoded via OpenRouteService. Without ORS_API_KEY the server falls back to a straight-line estimate and says so in `source` and `warning`.

Creates a booking (PENDING). Send `serviceType` (WEDDING, TRIP, VIP) and, for a trip, `destinationId` (then startPoint/endPoint are optional: the trip starts at the company and ends at the destination). Priced exactly like POST /bookings/estimate-price; the booking keeps `serviceType`, `destinationId` and `priceLines`. An endTime earlier than startTime means the trip ends the next morning (e.g. 22:00 to 01:00); it must end by Settings `overnightLatestEndHour` (default 06:00; 400 otherwise, and 0 turns trips past midnight off). Also 400 for a trip shorter than `minTripMinutes` (default 30), more than `maxAdvanceBookingDays` ahead (default 365), or a start more than 15 minutes in the past today. Clashes with the car, the driver or maintenance are checked across midnight. Only the car's own drivers can drive it: a chosen driver must be one of them (400 "This driver isn't assigned to this car"); otherwise the main driver is tried first, then the others. 400 "This car has no driver assigned yet", 400 on a retired car or a maintenance day, 409 when the car is too close to another trip or none of its drivers is free.

request.description: Cancels a booking (DELETE). Settles the money paid by the cancellation policy (Settings `freeCancellationHours`, default 48): cancelled that long before the start, everything paid goes back to the customer's wallet; later, the deposit is kept and anything above it goes back. An admin may send `refundDeposit: true|false` to decide either way (ignored from a customer). The booking gets `cancelledAt`, `depositOutcome` (REFUNDED, KEPT or null when nothing was paid) and `depositRefunded`; the response also has `cancellation` (paid, refund, kept). Releases availability & driver and promotes waitlist position #1. Cancelling twice changes nothing.
